column1: # Real, popular packages at pinned versions: an outside check on false alarms, completion and review
# burden (critique points #2 and #6). Chosen for variety, not popularity alone: install scripts that
# download binaries (and so hit Airlock's blocked egress), native builds, big dependency trees.
# Columns: target, expected verdict, label. Run: evals/product_regression.py --targets evals/real_packages.tsv

column3: esbuild: postinstall checks its platform binary
sharp: install script, prebuilt native binary
bcrypt: install downloads a binary from GitHub, else builds
prisma: postinstall downloads engines from its CDN
